articles.availability_note: Catch-up edition: prepared for 2026-11-09; first published November 13, 2026. PSI announced the proof on November6; the human exposition is datedNovember7 and Aaronson’s discussionNovember8. The scope is quantum query complexity for decision problems on most inputs, not a general limit on quantum hardware, factoring or physical simulation. Formal-check records are supplied by the proof authors; this publication did not rebuild them. The proprietary discovery system’s exact model and costs remain unknown.
